rom.description: A legally dumped Wario Land 3 GBC ROM (EN/JP is intended, but should work with other regions)
rom._description_source: setup guide: "A LEGALLY DUMPED Wario Land 3 GBC ROM (EN/JP is intended, but should work with other regions)". The guide also requires the file be named exactly `warioland3.gbc`.
rom._hash_note: The world declares NO base-ROM hash: wl3/rom.py sets `hash = None` on WL3ProcedurePatch, commented "no hash check -- any WL3 ROM version accepted". London can only warn, never reject, and that matches the world's own intent.

client.name: Archipelago's BizHawk Client
client._source: SCHEMA rule 1, read from the world itself: RvPA-Roopa/Wario-Land-3-Archipelago wl3/client.py, 2026-08-23 -- `class WL3Client(BizHawkClient)` with `game = "Wario Land 3"`, `system = "GBC"`, `patch_suffix = ".apwl3"`. The guide agrees, naming the "BizHawk Client". Rule 2 satisfied 2026-08-23: Plugins/Scripts/games/wario_land_3.lua written from the world's source (RvPA-Roopa/Wario-Land-3-Archipelago commit 5c4d5411), machine-proven (id diff + boot-garbage gate), NOT played — checks_verified stays false.

apworld._source: catalog/sheet_links.json, "APWorld, Poptracker" link for Wario Land 3. The setup guide only says "select the wl3.apworld you downloaded" without naming a source.

patch._source: world source: wl3/rom.py, read 2026-08-23 -- `class WL3ProcedurePatch(APProcedurePatch, APTokenMixin)` with `patch_file_ending = ".apwl3"`. The guide agrees: double-clicking the `.apwl3` file opens the patched game in BizHawk.

_patch_extension_source: world source: wl3/rom.py, read 2026-08-23 -- the world DOES define an APPatchExtension, `WL3PatchExtension`, with the steps capture_vanilla, apply_form_icons, apply_palette_shuffle, apply_enemizer and _write_enemizer_room_map. Every one of those is a NEW step name; none collides with the generic set (apply_bsdiff4, apply_tokens, copy, calc_snes_crc, apply_ips, apply_xdelta). That is the SAFE class: London's patcher refuses unknown steps loudly instead of producing a silently wrong ROM, so the game would play unpatched rather than broken.
